interview.name: Jules
interview.answer: The repair drive is still tentative, and no confirmed time or location has been set.

reflections: Jules is coordinating the repair drive and taking ownership of follow-up tasks.
Opal is focused on keeping the house list accurate and tracking which addresses have already been covered.
Vik is supportive and proactive, handling outreach to neighbors and keeping Jules informed.
Jules is coordinating the repair drive and is the main point of contact for confirmations and logistics.
Vik is supportive and proactive, willing to recruit neighbors and gather interest.
Kira wants concrete details before moving forward, while Tess is in a lighter support role, relaying updates as they come.
Jules is coordinating the group and tends to give calm, status-based updates while promising to confirm details later.
Tess is responsive but low on new information, and her role is mainly to relay anything she hears.
Kira and Mina want concrete logistics fast, especially exact time, location, and what to bring.
Jules is the main coordinator and tends to manage expectations by promising updates once details are confirmed.
Mina, Pia, and Bo are responsive but need timely confirmation about logistics before they can commit or act.
The group prefers concise, direct status updates about time, place, and required items, with Jules as the point person.
Jules is the main coordinator, repeatedly promising to confirm timing, location, and needed items.
The others are responsive and willing to help, but they are waiting on Jules for final logistics before acting.
The repair drive is still in planning mode, with volunteers offering supplies and asking for clear instructions.

events.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Opal: We still need to check which houses are left on the list and note any addresses that already got covered.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Jules: Got it—I’ll go through the list and mark any covered addresses so we know what’s left.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and see who can help out.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that would be a huge help. Let me know who’s interested, and I’ll line up the details.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll ask around today and let you know who’s interested.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Kira: Do we have the repair drive confirmed yet, or is it still tentative?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Jules: It’s still tentative, but I’m checking the list and lining up who’s available. Once I hear back, I can confirm what’s left and what we still need.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — please confirm the exact time, location, and what we need to bring once you hear back.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Tess: I haven’t heard anything new yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I do.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — appreciate you keeping an ear out. I’ll keep updating the list on my side, and let me know if anything comes up.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll pass along anything I hear about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Jules: It’s still tentative, but I’m checking the list and lining up who’s available. Once I hear back, I can confirm what’s left and what we still need.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Bo: Got it—just keep me posted on what’s still needed, and I’ll send anything I remember.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I hear back, and thanks for helping keep track of what’s still needed.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Mina: What time should I meet you?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Jules: It’s still tentative, but I’ll confirm the exact time and place as soon as I hear back. I’ll also let you know what to bring.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Mina: Okay, please text me as soon as you have it.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact time and drop-off spots before I can head over. Once that’s confirmed, I can bring what’s needed.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Pia — I’m still waiting on those details too, and I’ll send the exact time and drop-off spots as soon as I get them.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’ll hold off until the exact time and drop-off spots are set. Please let me know as soon as you have them.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Jules: Still tentative, but I’m checking on the exact time and place now. I’ll keep you posted on what to bring, too.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Bo: Sounds good—just keep me posted on the time, place, and what’s still needed.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the time and place, and then I’ll let you know what else is needed.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Oren: Oh, right — I said I’d bring my drill and a few extension cords. I’ll drop them off for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks, Oren — that’ll be really helpful. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything else comes up for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Oren: Sure thing — if you need anything else for the repair drive, just let me know. I’m happy to help.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Jules: It’s still tentative, but I’ll confirm the exact time and place as soon as I hear back. I’ll also let you know what to bring.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Mara: Sounds good — just keep me posted, and I’ll bring whatever’s still needed.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as the repair drive time and drop-off spot are confirmed.
events.speaker: Jules
